parameters.subject: Application Update — You’ve Been Shortlisted for the Next Round
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $('Prepare Resume').first().json.candidate_name }},

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Front-End Developer position with us.

We’re pleased to share that your application has been shortlisted for the next stage of our selection process. Your profile and experience stood out to our team, and we’d be happy to learn more about you.

Our recruitment team will reach out shortly with the interview schedule and details regarding the next steps.

We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to connecting with you.

Best regards,
The Recruitment Team

parameters.subject: An Update on Your Application
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $('Prepare Resume').first().json.candidate_name }},

Thank you for your interest in the Front-End Developer position and for the time and effort you invested in the application process.

After carefully reviewing your profile, we’ve decided not to move forward with your application for this particular opportunity.

Please don’t let this decision discourage you. Every application is a step forward, and every experience brings you closer to the right opportunity. We encourage you to keep building, learning, and pursuing the goals you’re passionate about.

We’ll be happy to keep your profile in mind for future opportunities that may be a stronger match for your skills and experience.

Wishing you all the very best in your journey ahead. Keep learning, keep growing, and keep going!

Best regards,
The Recruitment Team
